data.name: Majid
data.gender_notes: Majid is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root م-ج-د (m-j-d), 'to be glorious'. Majīd means 'glorious'. Its root is م-ج-د (m-j-d). One of the 99 names of Allah (al-Majīd). Majid is a Arabic name meaning “Glorious; magnificent”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Majid expresses “Glorious; magnificent”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root م-ج-د (m-j-d), 'to be glorious'. Majīd means 'glorious'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Majid total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
